result.summary: The application UI appears generally functional, but there is one significant visual clipping issue with the bottom card.

issues.description: The card at the bottom of the screen (featuring a pizza) has its top portion significantly clipped/overlapped by the content above it, or it is incorrectly positioned relative to the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the vertical spacing and margins of the scrollable container to ensure that the content is fully visible and not obstructed by the preceding 'Popular right now' section elements.
